aegis.name: Aegis
aegis.identity: Slow, armoured, holds ground. Rewards standing still.
aegis.trait_desc: After 0.4s without moving, take 30% less damage.

kestrel.name: Kestrel
kestrel.identity: Fast and fragile. Damage scales with staying in motion.
kestrel.trait_desc: Moving builds Momentum (max 5); each stack is +7% damage. Standing still bleeds it away.

nihil.name: Nihil
nihil.identity: Fragile status caster. Every enemy meets a curse first.
nihil.trait_desc: Your first hit on each enemy applies Shock (they take +10% damage for 4s).
